claims.claim: MICE denotes Meetings, Incentives, Conventions, and Exhibitions, the hospitality sector that plans and hosts organized gatherings for organizations.

The event-planning process moves through defined stages: discovery/strategy (purpose, SMART goals, stakeholders, KPIs), pre-planning (feasibility, budget, date/venue, workflows), design (run of show, floor plan, catering, AV), marketing and registration, execution, and post-event assessment.

The Banquet Event Order (BEO) is the written master document for a catered event, listing service start and stop times, service type, menu, and known allergens, used to coordinate the venue's departments.
Venue sourcing runs in two steps, a request for proposal (RFP) sent to candidate properties followed by an in-person or virtual site visit, and can be aided by a DMO or DMC.

Event budgets separate fixed costs (unchanged by attendance, e.g., room rental, speaker fees, AV) from variable costs (scaling with headcount, e.g., per-person catering, name badges), and events may be revenue-generating, revenue neutral, or revenue negative.

Risk management identifies risks by category, evaluates likelihood and severity (often on a risk matrix), and responds by accepting, mitigating, transferring (via insurance or contracts), or avoiding the risk.

U.S. meeting, convention, and event planners had a median annual wage of $59,440 in May 2024, about 155,800 jobs in 2024, projected 5 percent employment growth from 2024 to 2034 (faster than average), about 15,500 openings per year over the decade, and a bachelor's degree as typical entry-level education.

Global business events were estimated by a 2023 Events Industry Council study (using Oxford Economics analysis) at roughly a $1.6 trillion industry supporting about 10.9 million direct jobs worldwide.
The Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) credential is administered by the Events Industry Council and requires qualifying experience plus a passing examination.

conflictingEvidence.issue: The SBCTC OER's BEO description is narrower (service times, service type, menu, allergens) than the broadest industry usage in which the BEO also carries room setup, AV, and billing details for all departments.
positions: OER: BEO lists food service times, service type, menu, and allergens for a catered event
Broader industry practice: the BEO is the master document distributed to all venue departments covering setup, timing, menu, AV, and billing
conflictingEvidence.resolution: The lesson describes the BEO as the master operational document covering service times, service style, menu, allergens, and setup, which is consistent with the OER while framing its coordinating role accurately; no billing figures or department lists were asserted beyond what the source supports.

unsupportedExistingClaims: The machine-generated draft was treated as editorial intent only; its specific wording was not relied on as evidence and was discarded.
correctionsNeeded: Replaced boilerplate with a source-verified account of the planning process, logistics, budgeting, risk management, and the BLS planner data.
Kept catering strictly as a coordinated service (service style, timing, allergens, guarantee) rather than teaching kitchen or menu operations, per anti-duplication boundaries.

Prose written originally; CC BY 4.0 attribution recorded.
